1057 | async fn default_resolve_version(
1058 |     base_path: &Path,
1059 |     version: u64,
1060 |     object_store: &dyn OSObjectStore,
1061 | ) -> Result<ManifestLocation> {
1062 |     if is_detached_version(version) {
1063 |         return Ok(ManifestLocation {
1064 |             version,
1065 |             // Detached versions are not supported with V1 naming scheme.  If we need
1066 |             // to support in the future we could use a different prefix (e.g. 'x' or something)
1067 |             naming_scheme: ManifestNamingScheme::V2,
1068 |             // Both V1 and V2 should give the same path for detached versions
1069 |             path: ManifestNamingScheme::V2.manifest_path(base_path, version),
1070 |             size: None,
1071 |             e_tag: None,
1072 |             identity: None,
1073 |         });
1074 |     }
1075 | 
1076 |     // try V2, fallback to V1.
1077 |     let scheme = ManifestNamingScheme::V2;
1078 |     let path = scheme.manifest_path(base_path, version);
1079 |     match object_store.head(&path).await {
1080 |         Ok(meta) => Ok(ManifestLocation {
1081 |             version,
1082 |             path,
1083 |             size: Some(meta.size),
1084 |             naming_scheme: scheme,
1085 |             e_tag: meta.e_tag,
1086 |             identity: None,
1087 |         }),
1088 |         Err(ObjectStoreError::NotFound { .. }) => {
1089 |             // fallback to V1
1090 |             let scheme = ManifestNamingScheme::V1;
1091 |             Ok(ManifestLocation {
1092 |                 version,
1093 |                 path: scheme.manifest_path(base_path, version),
1094 |                 size: None,
1095 |                 naming_scheme: scheme,
1096 |                 e_tag: None,
1097 |                 identity: None,
1098 |             })
1099 |         }
1100 |         Err(e) => Err(e.into()),
1101 |     }
1102 | }

654 | /// Build version metadata for a fragment if it has physical rows and no existing metadata.
655 | pub fn build_version_meta(
656 |     fragment: &Fragment,
657 |     current_version: u64,
658 | ) -> Option<RowDatasetVersionMeta> {
659 |     if let Some(physical_rows) = fragment.physical_rows
660 |         && physical_rows > 0
661 |     {
662 |         // Verify row_id_meta exists (sanity check for stable row IDs)
663 |         if fragment.row_id_meta.is_none() {
664 |             panic!("Can not find row id meta, please make sure you have enabled stable row id.")
665 |         }
666 | 
667 |         // Use physical_rows directly as the authoritative row count
668 |         // This is correct even for compacted fragments where row_id_meta might
669 |         // have been partially copied
670 |         let version_sequence = RowDatasetVersionSequence::from_uniform_row_count(
671 |             physical_rows as u64,
672 |             current_version,
673 |         );
674 | 
675 |         return Some(RowDatasetVersionMeta::from_sequence(&version_sequence).unwrap());
676 |     }
677 |     None
678 | }
